name: Honda CJ360T
engine: 356 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, five-speed
intro: A budget version of the CB360 with one exhaust and fewer extras. Shares most engine parts with the CB360.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
